description_en: Updates the basic information of an operating system version by calling UpdateOsVersion
description_zh: 调用UpdateOsVersion更新系统版本的基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc update-os-version --is-milestone Y --is-force-night-upgrade N --project-id P0VFCREU --device-model-id 12 --system-version 2.0.1-R-20180501.1208 --release-note '改用UI用户体验，提升系统稳定性' --is-force-upgrade N --night-upgrade-download-type 1 --night-upgrade-is-show-tip N --night-upgrade-is-allowed-cancel N --rom-list 10_0_http://www.oss-server.com/file0.zip,11_123_http://www.oss-server.com/file1.zip,0_124_http://www.oss-server.com/file2.zip --id 123456 --enable-mobile-download Y --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateOsVersion

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the version is a milestone. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.name: is_milestone

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force a night upgrade. Valid values: Y and N. This parameter and IsForceUpgrade cannot both be set to Y
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制夜间升级，Y或N；与强制升级不能同时选择是
parameters.name: is_force_night_upgrade

parameters.example: 改用UI用户体验，提升系统稳定性
parameters.help_en: The release notes for the version. This information is displayed to users on the client as upgrade instructions
parameters.help_zh: 版本发布说明，客户端展示升级说明
parameters.name: release_note

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the version. This information is used only for server-side management and maintenance
parameters.help_zh: 版本备注，仅用于服务端管理维护
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force an upgrade. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.name: is_force_upgrade

parameters.help_en: The blacklist of operating system versions, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 系统版本黑名单列表，英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: black_version_list

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of operating system versions, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 系统版本白名单列表，英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: white_version_list

parameters.help_en: The maximum version code of the allowed OTA SDK version
parameters.help_zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最大版本versioncode
parameters.name: max_client_version

parameters.help_en: The minimum version code of the allowed OTA SDK version
parameters.help_zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最小版本versioncode
parameters.name: min_client_version

parameters.help_en:
The download type for night upgrades. Valid values:
1: download over Wi-Fi only
2: download over any network
parameters.help_zh: 夜间升级下载类型，1表示WIFI下下载，2表示任全网下载
parameters.name: night_upgrade_download_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display a prompt dialog box during a night upgrade. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.help_zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，Y或N
parameters.name: night_upgrade_is_show_tip

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display a prompt dialog box during a night upgrade. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.help_zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，Y或N
parameters.name: night_upgrade_is_allowed_cancel

parameters.help_en:
The list of upgrade packages, including full and incremental packages.

Format: `id|baseVersion|romUrl,id|baseVersion|romUrl`.

The first field is the ID of the upgrade package. Set this field to 0 for a new upgrade package.
The second field is the base operating system version number. The base version number for a full package is 0.
The last field is the download URL of the upgrade package
parameters.help_zh:
升级包列表，包括全量包和增量包。

格式为：`id|baseVersion|romUrl,id|baseVersion|romUrl`。

第一位指升级包的ID，如果是新的升级包，则为0。
第二位为基准系统版本号，全量包的基准系统版本号位0。
最后一位为升级包下载地址
parameters.name: rom_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow downloading upgrade packages over a mobile network
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许移动网络下载升级包
parameters.name: enable_mobile_download

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of packages that can be downloaded over a mobile network, in MB. When mobile network download is enabled, packages larger than this limit are not automatically downloaded
parameters.help_zh: 允许移动网络下载的包的最大限制，单位为M，在允许移动网络下载包的情况下，大于该限制的包也不会自动下载
parameters.name: mobile_download_max_size
